answer.reason: ACT 18:2 states one deed of Claudius, his command that all Jews leave Rome.

clauses.english: commanded all Jews to depart from Rome
clauses.quote: Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome

doubts: ACT 23:26 names Claudius Lysias, a Roman commander, not the emperor, so I left it out.
ACT 17:7 says only 'Caesar' without naming Claudius, so I left it out.
ACT 11:28 gives only the time of the famine, which the summary already covers, so I made no clause of it.
